notes: Original chronological test retained as future-domain stress test; benign calibration reserved only from original normal training when validation has no benign.
Radio benign labels mean absence of the labelled attack, not guaranteed healthy wireless conditions.
UE and RNTI are experimental identifiers, not verified persistent physical-device identities.
Original dlBytes and ulBytes are retained in prepared data; derived byte rates flag resets and gaps as unavailable.
pcmax=-29 is retained and flagged for encoding review; it is not assumed to be a true physical fault.

quality.rule: nonnegative counter difference / elapsed seconds within UE,cell,RNTI; 0<dt<=5; no resets joined
quality.semantics: counter-derived exploratory byte rate; not an externally certified throughput measurement

quality.rule: nonnegative counter difference / elapsed seconds within UE,cell,RNTI; 0<dt<=5; no resets joined
quality.semantics: counter-derived exploratory byte rate; not an externally certified throughput measurement

interpretation: Retrospective calibrated exploration; calibration fraction is not independent performance or a guaranteed future false-positive rate.

input_imputation.rule: fit-reference mode for CQI/RI/pcmax; median for other KPIs; per-context
input_imputation.no_fit_observations: leave missing and unscored; do not borrow calibration/test values
input_imputation.qualification: Predictions on imputed values are model outputs for estimates, not measured KPI health.

reasons.dlByteRate: 保留会话内下行字节增量速率，描述下行业务负载；沿用已有差分与会话边界规则。
reasons.ulByteRate: 保留会话内上行字节增量速率，描述上行业务负载；沿用已有差分与会话边界规则。
reasons.dlBler: 下行误块率直接反映下行传输可靠性。
reasons.ulBler: 上行误块率直接反映上行传输可靠性。
reasons.rsrp: 保留原来源参考信号接收功率字段，描述信号强度；按既有设备、场景和制式上下文分别建模。
reasons.rsrq: 保留原来源参考信号接收质量字段，补充信号质量信息；不与NR专属字段合并。
reasons.sinr: 保留原来源信干噪比字段，描述信号与干扰噪声的相对关系。
reasons.cqi: 保留信道质量反馈等级，用于解释无线链路质量和调制编码选择。
reasons.dlMcs: 保留下行调制编码等级，体现下行链路自适应状态。
reasons.ulMcs: 保留上行调制编码等级，体现上行链路自适应状态。

excluded_reasons.ri: 原拟合参考为常量，适合作一致性检查而非核心性能异常检测KPI。
excluded_reasons.phr: 功率余量作为辅助诊断信息保留，本核心集合优先传输质量与业务负载。
excluded_reasons.pcmax: 最大发射功率约束属于配置/能力描述且档位较少，不作为本核心性能告警项。
excluded_reasons.rssi: 总接收功率与已选RSRP、SINR的强度/质量信息部分重叠，精简时不重复参与核心OR。
excluded_reasons.pucchSnr: 控制信道SNR保留作细分排查，核心质量集合已包含SINR。
excluded_reasons.puschSnr: 共享信道SNR保留作细分排查，核心质量集合已包含SINR。

selected_feature_policy.source_metadata_quality_fields: preserved source-level annotations; not selected-KPI missingness denominators

record_rule: No record-level predictions are reused here. Run summarize_by_label separately for within-method any-applicable-KPI OR with undetermined records retained.
label_interpretation: Dataset attack/benign labels are not per-KPI health truth; unknown and unlabelled records remain separate.
